definitions.explanation: An inn where travellers stay and are fed, especially an old-fashioned Japanese one; today it sounds dated or storybook, and modern ones are called {旅館|りょかん}.

examples.japanese: {宿屋|やどや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まる→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
⟦{宿場町|しゅくばまち}→宿場町：24771_shukubamachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{宿屋|やどや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいた→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。

⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅人|たびびと}→旅人：12725_tabibito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{日|ひ}が{暮|く}れる→日が暮れる：16774_higakureru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{近|ちか}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{宿屋|やどや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{休|やす}んだ→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: Travellers in the old days would go into a nearby inn and rest when the sun went down.

notes:
Common in folk tales, period dramas, and role-playing games (where the inn that restores your health is the {宿屋|やどや}).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{宿|やど}→宿：03641_yado⟧: lodging, a place to stay; the general word
- ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧: a Japanese-style inn today
- ⟦{民宿|みんしゅく}→民宿：08165_minshuku⟧: a family-run guesthouse
